name: Sexual and Underworld Games
oneLine: Let's You and Him Fight, Perversion, Rapo, the Stocking Game, and Uproar run on attraction and rejection; Cops and Robbers, Want Out, and FOOJY run on crime and pursuit - different settings, same Formula G underneath.
whatYouDid: You caught Deven leaving the price tag in plain sight and getting visibly relieved rather than scared at being caught - the tell of Cops and Robbers - and asked what was actually going on instead of just delivering the consequence.

fromBook.quote: Cops and Robbers is a version of the same game played in a legal setting.

expand.definition: Both families follow ordinary Formula G; the setting changes what the Con and Payoff look like. Rapo signals a come-on, then rejects whoever responds to it - NIGYSOB's sexual form. Cops and Robbers sets up to get caught, trading Persecutor for Victim at the Switch, the same shift Kick Me makes in a living room.
expand.otherFraming: The Switch is what separates a true Underworld game from an actual career criminal who simply hasn't been caught yet - the game only exists once someone is, even unconsciously, angling to get caught.
expand.tryThisToday: If you notice someone leaving an obvious trail toward getting "caught" at something small, try asking what they actually want noticed, instead of just responding to the rule being broken.
